snippet.title: Isles & Tiles Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the teaser trailer for Isles & Tiles, a turn-based resource management game where you balance expanding your island, growing your colony, and gathering resources against the needs of your colony and the draw of your cards. Start with a core deck and unlock new cards, events, trophies, and modifiers as you explore new paths to victory!

Wishlist on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165460/Isles__Tiles) or join the mailing list (https://birdworks.io/games/islesandtiles) to get early access!
